newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed gets $400 mln deal with Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed gets $400 mln deal with Hungary.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said Friday it has received a contract worth about $400 million over six years to provide the AEGIS combat system to Spain.
Under the deal, the AEGIS combat system will be provided to the Spanish Navy through an agreement with the U.S. Navy.
Lockheed will provide four combat systems, with work beginning in the second quarter, it said. The systems are for a newly approved F-100 class of frigates.

Lockheed also said it has signed an agreement with the Hungarian government for expanded, industrial cooperation. The plan includes provisions for the worldwide marketing of Hungary's products, and options for industrial investments and joint ventures in the country, Lockheed said.
